title: Five minutes from my Claude assisted game - The cost of stars
author: azzaisme
selftext:
It's been an awesome journey to get here. And a short one, as this has been about 1.5 months in the making and it started of as a game of pong with a dash button. 

It's not in a pace where a full story exists, there's dialogue, assets are all visually matched, bosses are difficult but balanced, and there's a lot to do between runs. 

It's a rougelike game (think of Hades crossed with space invaders). 

Happy to talk about any questions anyone may have but I'm pretty proud of this one and can't wait to release it on steam soon
